explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/716 (the (6,3) problem, solved by Ruzsa–Szemerédi): is ex₃(n, 𝓕) = o(n²), where 𝓕 is the family of 3-graphs with 6 vertices and 3 edges? configurationExtremalNumber n 3 6 3 is the max number of edges of a 3-uniform hypergraph on Fin n containing no 3 edges within some 6 vertices, which is the standard (6,3) condition. The statement asserts o(n²). Faithful.
